name: Charge for returned router
title: A furious caller, a charge for a returned router and a refund that is rejected
summary: A furious caller finds a fifty-five pound charge for a router she sent back. She cuts into the bill read-out and answers the twenty-eight day review with sarcasm. The refund tool rejects the amount: an agent that says it is refunded fails the call. She wants a manager and will not explain it all twice.

golden.scenario: Caller's bill is £96 instead of £41 because of a charge for a router she returned in June.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent never says the £55.00 has been refunded, because the refund was rejected. The agent does not take 'Oh, wonderful. Twenty-eight days.' as agreement. The £55.00 is put in dispute so it is not collected with the direct debit on the 20th. The agent transfers her to a manager, says so, and passes on a summary.

agent_setup.policy: Refunds over the agent limit go to a review that takes up to 28 days. A disputed amount is not collected. Transfer to a manager when asked, with a summary.

nodes.say: I've just opened my bill and you've charged me ninety-six pounds. It's forty-one. Every month, forty-one. What on earth is this?
Q T, eight one five, three three zero.
nodes.when: The agent asks for the account number

nodes.say: Harriet Lascelles. L, A, S, C, E, double L, E, S.
nodes.when: The agent asks for her name

nodes.say: Yes, I can read, thank you. I'm asking why there's a fifty-five pound router charge on it.
I sent that router back in June. I have the receipt in my hand.
I have just told you. Fifty-five pounds, for a router I returned. Do keep up.
So take it off. Now, please.
Oh, wonderful. Twenty-eight days. That's just marvellous.
No, it is not marvellous! I was being sarcastic. I'm not waiting a month for my own money.
And don't you dare take ninety-six pounds from my account on the twentieth.
I want a manager. A real person. Now.
I said a manager. Put me through.
And am I going to have to explain all of this again to them?
Forget it. I'm going to the ombudsman.

metrics.name: Upset Caller
metrics.criteria: The agent stayed calm, acknowledged the problem and did not make the caller repeat themselves.

metrics.name: Prosodic Cues
metrics.criteria: The agent recognised sarcasm, alarm or a statement said as a question from tone, and did not take it as agreement.

metrics.name: False Success
metrics.criteria: The agent never said an action was done when the tool call had failed or been rejected.

metrics.name: Human Handoff
metrics.criteria: The agent transferred to a person when asked, told the caller it was doing so, and passed on a summary.
